sub_sector.value: Commercial roofing systems; building envelope weatherproofing

manufacturing_type.detail: Produces single-ply roofing membranes and polyiso insulation and fabricates engineered metal roofing panels.

product_complexity.detail: Warranted roofing systems and integrated weatherproofing systems manage water, vapor, air, and energy.

production_role.detail: Makes branded roofing and weatherproofing systems and supplies building materials such as polyiso insulation and single-ply membranes.

end_market_exposure.detail: Commercial buildings drive roofing demand, while weatherproofing serves both commercial and residential buildings.

notes: The evidence does not establish whether Carlisle manufactures to order, to stock, or both.
